supported_facts.fact: Both split histories isolate the January FBI January 6 personnel-identification/review directive associated with Acting Deputy Attorney General Emil Bove, not later Patel-era firings or polygraph use.

Reuters reported Bove instructed prosecutors to compile names of people who worked on January 6 investigations and described a related FBI list request; CNN reported an FBI email requesting personnel information so DOJ could review whether further actions were warranted. Both original held records cite the same Reuters story for this overlap.

distinct_actions_not_linked: Later Patel-era FBI dismissals in 2025–2026; Patel-directed polygraph use; headquarters transfer plan. Link only the overlapping FBI January 6 personnel-review/list directive.
